svg.title: East River
svg.desc: Interpretive vector after actual visual inspection. Approximate contours and interpretive screen colors. Dark blue rectangular field, two opposed open white curving forms, distinct upper and lower boundary contacts. The thin surrounding dark photo border is omitted. Curves simplified; title does not supply geometry. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of blue, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.artic.edu/artworks/57211; inspected 2026-10-27; interpretive study, not a facsimile.
